headline: 史坦能逝世 各界致敬
context: 美國女性主義先驅葛洛麗亞·史坦能（Gloria Steinem）辭世，享耆壽92歲。前國務卿希拉蕊．柯林頓（Hillary Clinton）率先在受訪時致敬，稱她是「整個女性平權架構的建築師之一」，波洛西、吉兒．拜登等政治人物與演藝界人士也紛紛表達哀悼。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Ex-secretary of state joins Nancy Pelosi, Jill Biden, Roxane Gay and others in heralding groundbreaking feminist Gloria Steinem, groundbreaking feminist campaigner, dies aged 92 ‘We badly need to raise our boys more like our girls’: Gloria Steinem – a life in quotes Leading figures from politics, entertainment and wider society led glowing tributes to Gloria Steinem on Thursday, with Hillary Clinton hailing the American feminist icon who died at 92 at home in New York City as “one of the architects of the entire structure of women’s equality”. Clinton, a former US secretary of state, presidential candidate and first lady, was among the first to jump in with praise early on Thursday when she appeared on the CBS Mornings TV show to share her respect and gratitude for Steinem. Continue reading...

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: After Ms. Steinem’s death at 92, celebrities and politicians reflected on her decades of activism for women’s rights and equality.
sources.title: Hillary Clinton, Meghan Markle, Lena Dunham and Others Pay Tribute to Gloria Steinem

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: In an era when feminists were stereotyped as unattractive, the pioneering writer’s style created a Trojan horse Gloria Steinem obituary Gloria Steinem: A life in pictures When people wanted to dismiss Gloria Steinem, they spoke about how she looked. Talking about the pioneering activist and journalist who turned feminism into a major civil rights movement, it might seem reductive to focus on her glasses. But after Steinem – whose death at 92 was announced on Thursday – wore them on the cover of Newsweek in 1971 next to the cover-line The New Woman, the lightly tinted aviators – often worn over her hair – became an accidental form of self-branding that made her instantly recognisable. They were as indelibly linked to her legacy as Ruth Bader Ginsburg’s jabots or even Anna Wintour’s sunglasses. They also became one of her greatest weapons. Continue reading...
sources.title: For Gloria Steinem, fashion was about much more than aesthetics

thread_text:
美國女性主義先驅葛洛麗亞·史坦能（Gloria Steinem）辭世，享耆壽92歲，她是在紐約家中過世的。前國務卿希拉蕊．柯林頓（Hillary Clinton）在受訪時率先致敬，稱她是「整個女性平權架構的建築師之一」。眾議院前議長波洛西（Nancy Pelosi）、前第一夫人吉兒．拜登（Jill Biden）等政治人物與演藝界人士，也紛紛表達哀悼。史坦能生前的招牌墨鏡，也成了她推動女性主義運動時最具辨識度的個人形象之一。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 4 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
美國女性主義先驅葛洛麗亞·史坦能（Gloria Steinem）辭世，享耆壽92歲，她是在紐約家中過世的。前國務卿希拉蕊．柯林頓在受訪時率先致敬，稱她是「整個女性平權架構的建築師之一」，眾議院前議長波洛西、前第一夫人吉兒．拜登等政治人物與演藝界人士，也紛紛表達哀悼。史坦能生前常戴的墨鏡，早年曾被拿來嘲諷她的外表，後來反而成了她推動女性主義運動時最具辨識度的個人標誌。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 4 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 女性主義先驅葛洛麗亞·史坦能過世了，享耆壽92歲，她是在紐約家中辭世的。前國務卿希拉蕊．柯林頓率先致敬，說她是「整個女性平權架構的建築師之一」。政壇與演藝圈也紛紛表達哀悼，包括前議長波洛西和前第一夫人吉兒．拜登。史坦能生前戴的那副墨鏡，早年曾被拿來嘲諷她的外表，後來反而成了她最具辨識度的個人標誌。
